title: excoecaria agallocha var. muelleriana
intro: Excoecaria agallocha var. muelleriana, commonly known as the Australian milk tree, is a plant species native to Australia. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, which include its potential anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Excoecaria agallocha var. muelleriana include its ability to act as a skin irritant, which can be used to treat skin conditions such as eczema and acne, and its antiseptic properties, which can aid in the treatment of wounds and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
